title: ファイナルズ開催危機！？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The URA Finale is set to be a huge success… until it's struck by an unexpected reversal of fortune.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The turf being grown for the race is destroyed by days of rough weather.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the event in peril, Director Akikawa sets out on her own to resolve the issue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tazuna and I both wish to help, but we're stumped as to how…
